fr.elements: Main Residence; Front Driveway; Vehicle Parking Area; Walkway; Open Lawn Area; Landscaped Area; Detached Structure; Perimeter Fencing; Dense Vegetation; Retaining Wall
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Dense Vegetation; Limited Rear Access; Vegetation Near Structure
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders locate the property quickly from the road.
• Trim vegetation along both sides of the driveway to maintain a clear path for emergency vehicles.
• Keep the driveway clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach the main residence without obstruction.
• Cut back dense vegetation near the detached structure to allow responders to move around it freely.
• Mark any gate or gap in the perimeter fencing that provides the most direct path to the rear of the property.
• Keep any gate in the perimeter fencing unlocked or fitted with a breakaway lock to allow responders to reach the rear without delay.
• Trim vegetation along the walkway to keep it passable for responders moving between the front and rear of the property.
• Clear a standing area near the driveway or open lawn that can serve as a staging area for equipment and personnel.
• Cut back any dense vegetation that blocks sightlines from the driveway to the main residence entrance.
• Mark the location of any utility shutoffs on the exterior of the main residence and detached structure so responders can find them without searching.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Shrubs; Scattered Trees; Tree Cluster; Vegetation Near Structure; Vegetation Near Structure; Open Terrain; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Grass Cover; Vegetation Along Driveway; Mixed Vegetation; Limited Rear Access; Single Access Route
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches and shrubs that are growing directly against or touching any side of the structure.
• Thin trees within the cluster nearest to the structure to create open space between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs growing beneath trees near the structure to break the connection between low plants and tree canopy.
• Clear grass and low vegetation in the area immediately surrounding the structure.
• Trim overhanging branches along the driveway to keep the travel lane open for vehicles.
• Cut back shrubs and mixed vegetation growing along the driveway edges that could slow or block vehicle movement.
• Keep the single access route clear of fallen branches, overgrown vegetation, and any debris that could block entry or exit.
• Clear vegetation and debris from the rear of the property to open a path for movement around the back of the structure.
• Mow or cut down grass cover near the structure, particularly where it connects to nearby shrubs or trees.
• Separate shrubs from one another where they grow close together near the structure to reduce the ability of fire to move between plants.
• Remove dead or dry material from within shrub groupings near the structure.
